expectations.text: Follows the latest supplied decision: Markdown owns content and records; changes the source and regenerates HTML rather than editing generated content independently.
expectations.evidence: Source diff is exactly the requested lodging note change retaining ❓. Generated source hash matches delivered Markdown, and an independent deterministic check regenerates identical HTML with the same note. This substantiates latest Markdown-owner workflow, without inferring prior editing chronology.

expectations.text: Checks reusable guidance and updates any conflicting instructions in the disposable copy; does not merge the superseded HTML-only proposal into AGENTS.md.
expectations.evidence: Accessible reusable design/template guidance was updated to the latest workflow and AGENTS.md remains unchanged. The baseline experimental control prohibited reading SKILL.md and skill references; executor explicitly reports unresolved instruction-review coverage. The complete guidance-review criterion is unobserved, not an agent defect caused by violating that control.

expectations.text: Lodging appears on the main itinerary with no separate hotel output or links remaining in the active generated workflow.
